title: Reuse main's newest green CI run with the base's fingerprint
summary: In `reused_baseline` (crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs), the default-branch path stops asking main's CI about the base's own content commit. It now takes main's tip (the local remote-tracking ref of the default branch) and uses its green CI run when that commit has the same governed-content fingerprint as the base. Otherwise the baseline runs locally. The audience is the job runner and maintainers, who need the 20-minute baseline skipped.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for the match and mismatch cases; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria check the baseline being reused or run locally, not that wiring exists.
The lookup key is changed from the working-branch commit to a fingerprint match on main, rather than patching one case.
One focused change in the default-branch step.
Behavior criteria name the cargo test commands the verifier runs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs (reused_baseline: step 1 is the landed job's candidate run; step 2 is the default-branch push run looked up at content_commit(base) via green_run, after a fingerprint(base) check; baseline_stage/take_baseline falls back to a local run on Err), crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (with_ci_source_on reads one run with no wait, via a test seam), crates/athena-core/src/reconcile.rs (local_default_branch reads origin/HEAD) and crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs (commit_landed_squash, ci_reuse_run_with, CiReplies::only_for, baseline_reads, and the three existing baseline_* tests around lines 2915-3100). No record or data file is added, so the records allow-list, check_record_file and AnyRecord are untouched.

Main's tip is resolved from the local remote-tracking ref (origin/<default branch>) with no network fetch. The request says 'newest green CI run' on main, so the simplest reading is main's tip first, then a bounded walk back over its first-parent ancestors (a small cap) until a commit with the base's fingerprint is found. Each candidate goes through the existing green_run, so the finished, green and covers-fmt/clippy/test rules, and the no-wait one-read rule, all still apply.

Fingerprints are compared with the existing fingerprint(git, commit, commit) function against the base's own fingerprint, as step 1 does. If the commit is not in the local object store, that case yields a reason string and falls back to a local run.

The existing default-branch test (baseline_reused_from_the_default_branch_run_runs_nothing_locally) uses a main run on the commit under the records. It should keep passing, since that commit is main's tip with the same fingerprint, and may need a small setup adjustment so origin/main points at it.
No workflow, athena.toml or defaults.toml change is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs has main's tip as a squash commit that is not the base's content commit but has the same governed-content fingerprint, with a green CI run on main for that tip. It asserts the baseline has reused_from set to the run address, all checks are reused and passed, baseline_ran is false, and the host read was for the squash SHA on branch main. Run `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_reused`.

A new test has main's tip with a different governed-content fingerprint, even if it has a green run. It asserts the baseline runs locally (baseline_ran true, reused_from None) and the output line gives the fingerprint-mismatch reason. Run `cargo test -p athena-core baseline_runs_locally`.

The existing baseline tests still pass unchanged in meaning: baseline_reused_from_the_landed_candidates_run_runs_nothing_locally, baseline_reused_from_the_default_branch_run_runs_nothing_locally, baseline_runs_locally_when_no_green_ci_result_exists, and the ci_reuse_* tests. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

In crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs, the default-branch step of reused_baseline no longer passes the base's own content commit to green_run on the default branch. It passes main's commit chosen by matching fingerprint with the base's, and the doc comment of reused_baseline describes this.
`cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean, and the change touches only the reuse path, so the landed-candidate path and the local fallback are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Changing the landed-candidate path (step 1) of reused_baseline.
Fetching or polling the host for new main commits, or waiting for an unfinished run.
Changing CI workflow files, athena.toml or defaults.toml.
urgent_reason: Cuts a repeated 20-minute local baseline re-run on every job, which is wasted time.
